routePlan.summary: Monster -> Unknown -> Unknown -> Monster -> Unknown -> Elite -> Monster -> RestSite -> Treasure -> RestSite -> Unknown -> RestSite -> Shop -> Monster -> RestSite -> Boss

runPlan.archetype: Permanent Strength + multi-hit AOE, exhaust Beckons
runPlan.bossPrep: Enter ≥90% HP with upgraded strength (Demon Form/Inflame), Whirlwind AOE, a hand-exhaust card (Burning Pact/True Grit) for Beckons, ~20 dmg/turn.
runPlan.summary: Gap of 2/turn plus ~25% error: add permanent Strength and AOE first, then 2–3 good block cards; delete Bane/Strikes. Elites only with high HP and a fire after; reach Soul Fysh near full HP with potions.
